Stafford.freeWeylRelation.signature:
Stafford.freeWeylRelation.{u_4, u_5} {k : Type u_4} {ι : Type u_5} [Field k] (omega : Matrix ι ι k)

Stafford.freeWeylRelation.source:
/-- The commutator relations presenting a Weyl-type algebra. -/
def freeWeylRelation (omega : Matrix ι ι k)
    (a b : FreeAlgebra k ι) : Prop :=
  ∃ i j,
    a = FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
      FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
    b = algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k ι) (omega i j)

Stafford38.OreCoordinateStage.coordinate.doc:
Ordinary polynomial differentiation, transported to the central Ore
stage.
Stafford38.OreCoordinateStage.coordinate.source:
/-- Ordinary polynomial differentiation, transported to the central Ore
stage. -/
def coordinateDerivation : OreDivisionDerivation (CoordinateStage (B := B)) where
  toFun z := normalForm zeroDerivation
    (Polynomial.derivative ((normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm z))
  map_zero' := by
    change normalForm zeroDerivation
      (Polynomial.derivative ((normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm 0)) = 0
    rw [(normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm.map_zero,
      Polynomial.derivative_zero, normalForm_zero]
  map_add' z w := by
    have h := (normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm.toAddHom.map_add z w
    change (normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm (z + w) =
      (normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm z +
        (normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm w at h
    change normalForm zeroDerivation
      (Polynomial.derivative ((normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm (z + w))) =
        normalForm zeroDerivation
            (Polynomial.derivative ((normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm z)) +
          normalForm zeroDerivation
            (Polynomial.derivative ((normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm w))
    rw [h, Polynomial.derivative_add, normalForm_add]
  leibniz' := by
    intro z w
    rcases normalForm_surjective zeroDerivation z with ⟨p, rfl⟩
    rcases normalForm_surjective zeroDerivation w with ⟨q, rfl⟩
    rw [← normalForm_mul_zeroDerivation]
    change normalForm zeroDerivation
      (Polynomial.derivative ((normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm
        (normalForm zeroDerivation (p * q)))) =
      normalForm zeroDerivation p *
          normalForm zeroDerivation
            (Polynomial.derivative ((normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm
              (normalForm zeroDerivation q))) +
        normalForm zeroDerivation
            (Polynomial.derivative ((normalFormAddEquiv zeroDerivation).symm
              (normalForm zeroDerivation p))) *
          normalForm zeroDerivation q
    rw [normalFormAddEquiv_symm_normalForm,
      normalFormAddEquiv_symm_normalForm, normalFormAddEquiv_symm_normalForm]
    rw [Polynomial.derivative_mul, normalForm_add,
      normalForm_mul_zeroDerivation, normalForm_mul_zeroDerivation]
    exact add_comm _ _

Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.nestedPol.doc:
Flatten two nested univariate polynomial layers into two commuting symbol
variables as an algebra equivalence over the coefficient ring.
Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.nestedPol.signature:
Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.nestedPolynomialAlgEquiv.{u_1} (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] :

Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.nestedPol.source:
/-- Flatten two nested univariate polynomial layers into two commuting symbol
variables as an algebra equivalence over the coefficient ring. -/
def nestedPolynomialAlgEquiv (R : Type*) [CommRing R] :
    Polynomial (Polynomial R) ≃ₐ[R]
      MvPolynomial (PUnit.{1} ⊕ PUnit.{1}) R :=
  (Polynomial.mapAlgEquiv ((MvPolynomial.pUnitAlgEquiv R).symm)).trans
    ((((MvPolynomial.pUnitAlgEquiv (MvPolynomial PUnit.{1} R)).symm
      ).restrictScalars R).trans
        (MvPolynomial.sumAlgEquiv R PUnit.{1} PUnit.{1}).symm)

/-- The scalar-linear form of `nestedPolynomialAlgEquiv`. -/
def nestedPolynomialLinearEquiv
    {k R : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] :
    Polynomial (Polynomial R) ≃ₗ[k]
      MvPolynomial (PUnit.{1} ⊕ PUnit.{1}) R :=
  (nestedPolynomialAlgEquiv R).toLinearEquiv.restrictScalars k

Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.normalFor.signature:
Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.normalFormLinearEquiv.{u_1, u_2} {k : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2}
  [CommRing k] [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (D : AlgebraicAnalysis.OreDivisionDerivation B)
  [Algebra k ↥(AlgebraicAnalysis.OreAssociativity.NormalOre D)]
  (hAlg :
    algebraMap k ↥(AlgebraicAnalysis.OreAssociativity.NormalOre D) =
      (AlgebraicAnalysis.OreAssociativity.normalCoefficient D).comp (algebraMap k B)) :
  Polynomial B ≃ₗ[k] ↥(AlgebraicAnalysis.OreAssociativity.NormalOre D)

Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.pairNorma.doc:
Expose the two coefficient-left polynomial layers of a pair stage and
apply a chosen linear coordinate system to the old coefficients.
Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.pairNorma.signature:
Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.pairNormalFormLinearEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {k : Type u_1}
  {B : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [CommRing k] [Ring B] [Algebra k B] [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
  [Algebra k ↥OreCoordinateStage.CoordinateStage] [Algebra k ↥OrePairStage.PairStage]
  (hInner :
    algebraMap k ↥OreCoordinateStage.CoordinateStage =
      (AlgebraicAnalysis.OreAssociativity.normalCoefficient OreCoordinateStage.zeroDerivation).comp
        (algebraMap k B))
  (hOuter :
    algebraMap k ↥OrePairStage.PairStage =
      (AlgebraicAnalysis.OreAssociativity.normalCoefficient
            OreCoordinateStage.coordinateDerivation).comp
        (algebraMap k ↥OreCoordinateStage.CoordinateStage))
  (e : B ≃ₗ[k] S) : ↥OrePairStage.PairStage ≃ₗ[k] Polynomial (Polynomial S)
Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.pairNorma.source:
/-- Expose the two coefficient-left polynomial layers of a pair stage and
apply a chosen linear coordinate system to the old coefficients. -/
def pairNormalFormLinearEquiv
    {k B S : Type*} [CommRing k] [Ring B] [Algebra k B]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    [Algebra k (CoordinateStage (B := B))]
    [Algebra k (PairStage (B := B))]
    (hInner : algebraMap k (CoordinateStage (B := B)) =
      (normalCoefficient zeroDerivation).comp (algebraMap k B))
    (hOuter : algebraMap k (PairStage (B := B)) =
      (normalCoefficient coordinateDerivation).comp
        (algebraMap k (CoordinateStage (B := B))))
    (e : B ≃ₗ[k] S) :
    PairStage (B := B) ≃ₗ[k] Polynomial (Polynomial S) :=
  (normalFormLinearEquiv coordinateDerivation hOuter).symm.trans
    (polynomialMapRangeLinearEquiv
      ((normalFormLinearEquiv zeroDerivation hInner).symm.trans
        (polynomialMapRangeLinearEquiv e)))

Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.polynomia.signature:
Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.polynomialFinsuppLinearEquiv.{u_1, u_2} {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2}

Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.polynomia.source:
/-- Polynomials are linearly equivalent to their coefficient finsupps. -/
def polynomialFinsuppLinearEquiv
    {k R : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [Semiring R] [Algebra k R] :
    Polynomial R ≃ₗ[k] (ℕ →₀ R) :=
  { (Polynomial.toFinsuppIso R).toAddEquiv.trans
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv k).toAddEquiv with
    map_smul' := by
      intro c p
      rfl }

Stafford38.OreLinearNormalForm.polynomia.source:
/-- Apply a linear equivalence independently to every polynomial
coefficient. -/
def polynomialMapRangeLinearEquiv
    {k R S : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [Semiring R] [Semiring S]

/-- The pair lift as a scalar-preserving algebra map. -/
def pairLiftAlgHom (f : B →ₐ[k] A) (X P : A)
    (hX : ∀ b, X * f b = f b * X)
    (hP : ∀ b, P * f b = f b * P)
    (hPX : P * X = X * P + 1) :
    PairStage (B := B) →ₐ[k] A where
  toRingHom := pairLift f.toRingHom X P hX hP hPX

    rw [pairStageAlgebra_algebraMap]
    exact pairLift_coefficient f.toRingHom X P hX hP hPX (algebraMap k B c)
      |>.trans (f.commutes c)

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsCompatibleFi.doc:
**Definition 2.4 (compatible filtration).** An exhaustive increasing chain
`M_0 ⊆ M_1 ⊆ …` of `k`-subspaces (`M_i = 0` for `i < 0`) with
`M_i F_j ⊆ M_{i+j}`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsCompatibleFi.source:
/-- **Definition 2.4 (compatible filtration).** An exhaustive increasing chain
`M_0 ⊆ M_1 ⊆ …` of `k`-subspaces (`M_i = 0` for `i < 0`) with
`M_i F_j ⊆ M_{i+j}`. -/
structure IsCompatibleFiltration (F : ℕ → Submodule k A) (Mf : ℕ → Submodule k M) :
    Prop where
  mono : Monotone Mf
  smul_mem : ∀ {i j : ℕ} {m : M} {a : A}, m ∈ Mf i → a ∈ F j →
    MulOpposite.op a • m ∈ Mf (i + j)
  exhaustive : ∀ m : M, ∃ i, m ∈ Mf i

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsFiltration.doc:
**Definition 2.3 (filtration).** `F_0 ⊆ F_1 ⊆ … ⊆ A` linear subspaces with
`F_i F_j ⊆ F_{i+j}` and `A = ⋃_j F_j`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsFiltration.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsFiltration.{u, v} {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type v} [Ring A]
  [Algebra k A] (F : ℕ → Submodule k A) : Prop
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsFiltration.source:
/-- **Definition 2.3 (filtration).** `F_0 ⊆ F_1 ⊆ … ⊆ A` linear subspaces with
`F_i F_j ⊆ F_{i+j}` and `A = ⋃_j F_j`. -/
structure IsFiltration (F : ℕ → Submodule k A) : Prop where
  mono : Monotone F
  mul_mem : ∀ {i j : ℕ} {a b : A}, a ∈ F i → b ∈ F j → a * b ∈ F (i + j)
  exhaustive : ∀ a : A, ∃ j, a ∈ F j

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsGoodFiltrati.doc:
**Definition 2.4 (good filtration).** A filtration `M_•` of a right
`A_n(k)`-module `M`, compatible with the order filtration `F_•`, is good if
`gr M = ⊕_i M_i/M_{i-1}` is finitely generated over `gr^F A_n = k[x, ξ]`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsGoodFiltrati.source:
/-- **Definition 2.4 (good filtration).** A filtration `M_•` of a right
`A_n(k)`-module `M`, compatible with the order filtration `F_•`, is good if
`gr M = ⊕_i M_i/M_{i-1}` is finitely generated over `gr^F A_n = k[x, ξ]`. -/
structure IsGoodFiltration (Γ : ℕ → Submodule k M) : Prop where
  compatible : IsCompatibleFiltration (orderFiltration k n) Γ
  finite : Module.Finite (SymbolRing k n) (GrModule Γ)

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.grPieceEquiv.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.grPieceEquiv.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] {n : ℕ}

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.grPieceEquiv.source:
/-- The graded piece `F_j/F_{j-1}` is the space of weighted-homogeneous symbols of
degree `j`, through the principal symbol. -/
def grPieceEquiv {n : ℕ} (w : PhaseVar n → ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
    grPiece (presentedWeightPiece k w) j ≃ₗ[k]
      MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w j :=

      ext a
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype, lowerPiece_weight, LinearMap.mem_ker,
        ← presentedPrincipalComponent_eq_zero_iff_mem_strictLower k w _ a.2]
      exact ⟨fun h => Subtype.ext h, fun h => congrArg Subtype.val h⟩)).trans
    (LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective _ (principalComponentOnPiece_surjective k w))

**Definition 2.8 (standard symplectic form).** On `𝕍 = k^{2n}` with basis
`x_1, …, x_n, ∂_1, …, ∂_n`, `ω(u, v) = ∑_i (u_{x_i} v_{∂_i} - u_{∂_i} v_{x_i})`,
so `ω(x_i, ∂_j) = δ_ij` and `ω(x_i, x_j) = ω(∂_i, ∂_j) = 0`.  It is the
negative of the repository's `phasePairing`, which uses the opposite sign
convention.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.omega.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.omega.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
  LinearMap.BilinForm k (Characteristic.PhaseVar n → k)
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.omega.source:
/-- **Definition 2.8 (standard symplectic form).** On `𝕍 = k^{2n}` with basis
`x_1, …, x_n, ∂_1, …, ∂_n`, `ω(u, v) = ∑_i (u_{x_i} v_{∂_i} - u_{∂_i} v_{x_i})`,
so `ω(x_i, ∂_j) = δ_ij` and `ω(x_i, x_j) = ω(∂_i, ∂_j) = 0`.  It is the
negative of the repository's `phasePairing`, which uses the opposite sign
convention. -/
def omega (n : ℕ) : BilinForm k (PhaseVar n → k) :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ k (fun u v => -phasePairing k u v)
    (fun u v w => by rw [phasePairing_add_left, neg_add])
    (fun c u v => by rw [phasePairing_smul_left, smul_eq_mul, mul_neg])
    (fun u v w => by rw [phasePairing_add_right, neg_add])
    (fun c u v => by rw [phasePairing_smul_right, smul_eq_mul, mul_neg])

    rw [MulOpposite.op_smul, smul_assoc]

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.poisson.source:
/-- **Definition 2.9 (Poisson bracket).**
`{f, g} = ∑_i (∂f/∂x_i ∂g/∂ξ_i - ∂f/∂ξ_i ∂g/∂x_i)` on `k[x, ξ]`. -/

  ∑ i : Fin n,
    (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i) f * MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i) g -
      MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i) f * MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i) g)

Stafford38.WeylFiltration.symbolWeightPi.signature:
Stafford38.WeylFiltration.symbolWeightPiece.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (w : Characteristic.PhaseVar n → ℕ) (N : ℕ) : Submodule k (Characteristic.SymbolRing k n)
Stafford38.WeylFiltration.symbolWeightPi.source:
/-- Symbols supported on monomials of weighted degree at most `N`. -/
def symbolWeightPiece {n : ℕ} (w : PhaseVar n → ℕ) (N : ℕ) :
    Submodule k (SymbolRing k n) where
  carrier := {f | ∀ m, MvPolynomial.coeff m f ≠ 0 → monomialWeight w m ≤ N}
  zero_mem' m hm := by simp at hm
  add_mem' {f g} hf hg m hm := by
    by_cases hfm : MvPolynomial.coeff m f = 0
    · apply hg m
      simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff_add, hfm] using hm
    · exact hf m hfm
  smul_mem' c f hf m hm := by
    apply hf m
    intro hfm
    apply hm
    simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_smul, hfm]

tower.

  Algebra k (OreIteratedPairStage.IteratedPairStage k n)
Stafford38.WeylIteratedEquivalence.itera.source:
/-- The scalar algebra structure inherited recursively by the iterated Ore
tower. -/
def iteratedPairStageAlgebra :
    (n : Nat) → Algebra k (IteratedPairStage k n)
  | 0 => by
      change Algebra k k
      infer_instance
  | n + 1 => by
      letI : Algebra k (IteratedPairStage k n) :=
        iteratedPairStageAlgebra n
      change Algebra k (PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n))
      exact pairStageAlgebra

Stafford38.WeylIteratedEquivalence.itera.doc: The recursive map from the Ore tower back to the quotient presentation.
Stafford38.WeylIteratedEquivalence.itera.signature:
Stafford38.WeylIteratedEquivalence.iteratedToPresented.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
  OreIteratedPairStage.IteratedPairStage k n →ₐ[k] PresentedWeyl k n
Stafford38.WeylIteratedEquivalence.itera.source:
/-- The recursive map from the Ore tower back to the quotient presentation. -/
def iteratedToPresented :
    (n : Nat) → IteratedPairStage k n →ₐ[k] PresentedWeyl k n
  | 0 => Algebra.ofId k (PresentedWeyl k 0)
  | n + 1 => by
      letI : Algebra k (IteratedPairStage k n) :=
        iteratedPairStageAlgebra k n
      letI : Algebra k (PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n)) :=
        pairStageAlgebra
      change PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n) →ₐ[k]
        PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)
      let f : IteratedPairStage k n →ₐ[k] PresentedWeyl k (n + 1) :=
        (previousWeylEmbedding k n).comp (iteratedToPresented n)
      exact pairLiftAlgHom f (presentedCoordinate k n) (presentedMomentum k n)
        (fun b => presentedCoordinate_commutes_previous k n
          (iteratedToPresented n b))
        (fun b => presentedMomentum_commutes_previous k n
          (iteratedToPresented n b))
        (presentedMomentum_mul_coordinate k n)

    IteratedPairStage k n →ₐ[k] IteratedPairStage k (n + 1) where
  toRingHom := stageEmbedding k n
  commutes' c := by
    change pairCoefficient (algebraMap k (IteratedPairStage k n) c) =
      @algebraMap k (PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n)) _ _
        (pairStageAlgebra (k := k) (B := IteratedPairStage k n)) c
    rw [pairStageAlgebra_algebraMap
      (k := k) (B := IteratedPairStage k n)]
    rfl

Stafford38.WeylPBW.iteratedNormalFormLin.doc:
Scalar-linear normal-form coordinates for the recursively iterated Ore
tower.
Stafford38.WeylPBW.iteratedNormalFormLin.signature:
Stafford38.WeylPBW.iteratedNormalFormLinearEquiv.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
  OreIteratedPairStage.IteratedPairStage k n ≃ₗ[k] Characteristic.SymbolRing k n
Stafford38.WeylPBW.iteratedNormalFormLin.source:
/-- Scalar-linear normal-form coordinates for the recursively iterated Ore
tower. -/
def iteratedNormalFormLinearEquiv :
    (n : Nat) → IteratedPairStage k n ≃ₗ[k] SymbolRing k n
  | 0 => (MvPolynomial.isEmptyAlgEquiv k (PhaseVar 0)).symm.toLinearEquiv
  | n + 1 => by
      letI : Algebra k (IteratedPairStage k n) :=
        iteratedPairStageAlgebra k n
      letI : Algebra k (CoordinateStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n)) :=
        coordinateStageAlgebra
      letI : Algebra k (PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n)) :=
        pairStageAlgebra
      change PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n) ≃ₗ[k] SymbolRing k (n + 1)
      exact (pairNormalFormLinearEquiv
        (normalOreAlgebra_algebraMap zeroDerivation (fun c => by
          exact zeroDerivation_apply (algebraMap k (IteratedPairStage k n) c)))
        (normalOreAlgebra_algebraMap coordinateDerivation
          coordinateDerivation_algebraMap)
        (iteratedNormalFormLinearEquiv n)).trans (flattenPairSymbols k n)

Stafford38.WeylPBW.phaseSuccEquiv.doc:
Reindex the two newest symbol variables followed by the old variables to
the standard newest-first coordinate/momentum indexing.
Stafford38.WeylPBW.phaseSuccEquiv.signature:
Stafford38.WeylPBW.phaseSuccEquiv (n : ℕ) :
  (PUnit.{1} ⊕ PUnit.{1}) ⊕ Characteristic.PhaseVar n ≃ Characteristic.PhaseVar (n + 1)
Stafford38.WeylPBW.phaseSuccEquiv.source:
/-- Reindex the two newest symbol variables followed by the old variables to
the standard newest-first coordinate/momentum indexing. -/
def phaseSuccEquiv (n : Nat) :
    ((PUnit.{1} ⊕ PUnit.{1}) ⊕ PhaseVar n) ≃ PhaseVar (n + 1) where
  toFun
    | .inl (.inl _) => .inr 0
    | .inl (.inr _) => .inl 0
    | .inr (.inl i) => .inl i.succ
    | .inr (.inr i) => .inr i.succ
  invFun
    | .inl i => Fin.cases (.inl (.inr PUnit.unit))
        (fun j => .inr (.inl j)) i
    | .inr i => Fin.cases (.inl (.inl PUnit.unit))
        (fun j => .inr (.inr j)) i
  left_inv x := by
    rcases x with (⟨⟨u⟩ | ⟨u⟩⟩ | ⟨i | i⟩) <;> rfl
  right_inv x := by
    rcases x with (i | i)
    · exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
    · exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i

Stafford38Challenge.EvolutionaryIdentity.doc:
**Section 7, evolutionary identity** (tex lines 1631–1634): for `r ≥ 1`, in
every `k`-algebra `D` with `px = xp + 1`, the element
`d = p^r − ∑_j a_j x^{m_j}`, each `a_j` commuting with `x` and `p`, has
`R, S` with `1 = dR + x^r d S`.
Stafford38Challenge.EvolutionaryIdentity.source:
/-- **Section 7, evolutionary identity** (tex lines 1631–1634): for `r ≥ 1`, in
every `k`-algebra `D` with `px = xp + 1`, the element
`d = p^r − ∑_j a_j x^{m_j}`, each `a_j` commuting with `x` and `p`, has
`R, S` with `1 = dR + x^r d S`. -/
def EvolutionaryIdentity : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] (D : Type v) [Ring D] [Algebra k D] (x p : D),
    p * x = x * p + 1 → ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → ∀ (J : ℕ) (a : Fin J → D) (m : Fin J → ℕ),
      (∀ j, a j * x = x * a j) → (∀ j, a j * p = p * a j) →
        ∃ R S : D, (1 : D) = (p ^ r - ∑ j, a j * x ^ m j) * R +
          x ^ r * (p ^ r - ∑ j, a j * x ^ m j) * S

Stafford38Challenge.HasDifferentialIdent.doc:
The identity `1 = dR + FdS` in the ring `D_k(B)` of finite-order
`k`-linear differential operators on `B`: for every nonzero `d ∈ D_k(B)` there
are `F, R, S ∈ D_k(B)` with `1 = dR + FdS`.
Stafford38Challenge.HasDifferentialIdent.signature:
Stafford38Challenge.HasDifferentialIdentity.{u, v} (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing k]
  [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] : Prop
Stafford38Challenge.HasDifferentialIdent.source:
/-- The identity `1 = dR + FdS` in the ring `D_k(B)` of finite-order
`k`-linear differential operators on `B`: for every nonzero `d ∈ D_k(B)` there
are `F, R, S ∈ D_k(B)` with `1 = dR + FdS`. -/
def HasDifferentialIdentity (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing k] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra k B] : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Module.End k B, IsDifferentialOperator k B d → d ≠ 0 →
    ∃ F R S : Module.End k B, IsDifferentialOperator k B F ∧ IsDifferentialOperator k B R ∧
      IsDifferentialOperator k B S ∧ (1 : Module.End k B) = d * R + F * d * S

/-- A right module `M` is cyclic: `M = mA` for some `m ∈ M`. -/
def IsCyclicModule (A : Type u) (M : Type v) [Ring A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ M] :

  ∃ m : M, ∀ x : M, ∃ a : A, x = MulOpposite.op a • m

Stafford38Challenge.IsDifferentialOperat.source:
/-- `P` is a `k`-linear differential operator of finite order on `B`. -/
def IsDifferentialOperator (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing k] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra k B] (P : Module.End k B) : Prop :=
  ∃ N, IsDifferentialOperatorOfOrder k B N P

Stafford38Challenge.IsDifferentialOperat.doc:
`P` is a `k`-linear differential operator of order at most `N` on the
commutative `k`-algebra `B` (Grothendieck): every iterated commutator
`[…[[P, b₀], b₁], …, b_N]` with multiplication operators vanishes, where
`[Q, b] = Q ∘ b − b ∘ Q`.
Stafford38Challenge.IsDifferentialOperat.signature:
Stafford38Challenge.IsDifferentialOperatorOfOrder.{u, v} (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing k]
  [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (N : ℕ) (P : Module.End k B) : Prop
Stafford38Challenge.IsDifferentialOperat.source:
/-- `P` is a `k`-linear differential operator of order at most `N` on the
commutative `k`-algebra `B` (Grothendieck): every iterated commutator
`[…[[P, b₀], b₁], …, b_N]` with multiplication operators vanishes, where
`[Q, b] = Q ∘ b − b ∘ Q`. -/
def IsDifferentialOperatorOfOrder (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing k] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra k B] (N : ℕ) (P : Module.End k B) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : List B, b.length = N + 1 →
    b.foldl (fun Q c => Q * LinearMap.mulLeft k c - LinearMap.mulLeft k c * Q) P = 0

Stafford38Challenge.IsStablyCyclic.doc:
Stafford's *stably cyclic* [Sta78, p. 435], as quoted in the proof of
Corollary 6.3 (tex line 1619): "given `l ≥ 1` and `a_1, …, a_{l+1} ∈ T` that
generate `T`, there exist `f_i ∈ A_n` such that `a_i + a_{l+1} f_i`,
`i = 1, …, l`, also generate `T`".
Stafford38Challenge.IsStablyCyclic.signature:
Stafford38Challenge.IsStablyCyclic.{u, v} (A : Type u) (T : Type v) [Ring A] [AddCommGroup T]
  [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T] : Prop
Stafford38Challenge.IsStablyCyclic.source:
/-- Stafford's *stably cyclic* [Sta78, p. 435], as quoted in the proof of
Corollary 6.3 (tex line 1619): "given `l ≥ 1` and `a_1, …, a_{l+1} ∈ T` that
generate `T`, there exist `f_i ∈ A_n` such that `a_i + a_{l+1} f_i`,
`i = 1, …, l`, also generate `T`". -/
def IsStablyCyclic (A : Type u) (T : Type v) [Ring A] [AddCommGroup T] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T] :
    Prop :=
  ∀ l ≥ 1, ∀ a : Fin (l + 1) → T, Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range a) = ⊤ →
    ∃ f : Fin l → A, Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ
      (Set.range fun i : Fin l => a i.castSucc + (MulOpposite.op (f i) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • a (Fin.last l)) =
        ⊤

Stafford38Challenge.PaperTheorem_1_1.doc:
**Theorem 1.1.**  For every field of characteristic zero `k`, every `n ≥ 0`
and every nonzero `d ∈ A_n(k)`, there exists an `F ∈ A_n(k)` such that
`A_n(k) = dA_n(k) + FdA_n(k)`, or equivalently, there exist `F, S, R ∈ A_n(k)`
such that `1 = dR + FdS`.  Moreover, if `n ≥ 1`, one may choose
`F = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)^{deg_B d}` for a linear `ω`-preserving automorphism `g`.
Stafford38Challenge.PaperTheorem_1_1.source:
/-- **Theorem 1.1.**  For every field of characteristic zero `k`, every `n ≥ 0`
and every nonzero `d ∈ A_n(k)`, there exists an `F ∈ A_n(k)` such that
`A_n(k) = dA_n(k) + FdA_n(k)`, or equivalently, there exist `F, S, R ∈ A_n(k)`
such that `1 = dR + FdS`.  Moreover, if `n ≥ 1`, one may choose
`F = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)^{deg_B d}` for a linear `ω`-preserving automorphism `g`. -/
def PaperTheorem_1_1 : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ) (d : WeylAlg k n), d ≠ 0 →
    (∃ F : WeylAlg k n, (⊤ : Submodule (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ (WeylAlg k n)) =
        Submodule.span (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ {d} ⊔ Submodule.span (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ {F * d}) ∧
      (∃ F S R : WeylAlg k n, (1 : WeylAlg k n) = d * R + F * d * S) ∧
      (∀ hn : 1 ≤ n, ∃ g : Matrix.symplecticGroup (Fin n) k, ∃ R S : WeylAlg k n,
        (1 : WeylAlg k n) = d * R +
          phiG k n g⁻¹ (x₁ k hn) ^ Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.bernsteinDegree k d * d * S)

Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.IsLinearW.doc:
A source coordinate obtained from an invertible symplectic linear change
of the canonical Weyl generators.
Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.IsLinearW.signature:
Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.IsLinearWeylCoordinate.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
  (ell : WeylAlg k (n + 1)) : Prop
Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.IsLinearW.source:
/-- A source coordinate obtained from an invertible symplectic linear change
of the canonical Weyl generators. -/
def IsLinearWeylCoordinate (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (ell : WeylAlg k (n + 1)) : Prop :=
  ∃ (M N : Matrix (PhaseVar (n + 1)) (PhaseVar (n + 1)) k)
      (_hM : M * standardForm k (n + 1) * Matrix.transpose M =
        standardForm k (n + 1))
      (_hN : N * standardForm k (n + 1) * Matrix.transpose N =
        standardForm k (n + 1))
      (_hMN : M * N = 1) (_hNM : N * M = 1),
      ell = linearCombination k N (generator k (n + 1))
        (.inl (0 : Fin (n + 1)))

Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.Universal.doc:
Shared template for the fixed-source proposition, parameterized only by
the chosen degree function.
Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.Universal.signature:
Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.UniversalFixedSourceStatementWithDegree.{u}
  (degree : (k : Type u) → [inst : Field k] → {n : ℕ} → WeylAlg k n → ℕ) : Prop
Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.Universal.source:
/-- Shared template for the fixed-source proposition, parameterized only by
the chosen degree function. -/
def UniversalFixedSourceStatementWithDegree
    (degree : ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] {n : ℕ}, WeylAlg k n → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ)
    (d : WeylAlg k (n + 1)), d ≠ 0 →
      ∃ ell R S : WeylAlg k (n + 1),
        IsLinearWeylCoordinate k n ell ∧
          (1 : WeylAlg k (n + 1)) =
            d * R + ell ^ degree k d * d * S

Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.freeOrder.doc: Ordered PBW words, with old pairs followed by the newest pair.
Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.freeOrder.signature:
Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.freeOrderedMonomial.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
  (Fin n → ℕ) → (Fin n → ℕ) → FreeAlgebra k (PhaseVar n)
Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.freeOrder.source:
/-- Ordered PBW words, with old pairs followed by the newest pair. -/
def freeOrderedMonomial (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → ℕ) → (Fin n → ℕ) → FreeAlgebra k (PhaseVar n)
  | 0, _, _ => 1
  | n + 1, a, p =>
      freeOldMap k n
          (freeOrderedMonomial k n (fun i => a i.succ) (fun i => p i.succ)) *
        FreeAlgebra.ι k (.inl (0 : Fin (n + 1))) ^ a 0 *
        FreeAlgebra.ι k (.inr (0 : Fin (n + 1))) ^ p 0

/-- The commutator relations presenting a Weyl-type algebra. -/

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsCompatibleFi.doc:
**Definition 2.4 (compatible filtration).** An exhaustive increasing chain
`M_0 ⊆ M_1 ⊆ …` of `k`-subspaces (`M_i = 0` for `i < 0`) with
`M_i F_j ⊆ M_{i+j}`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsCompatibleFi.source:
/-- **Definition 2.4 (compatible filtration).** An exhaustive increasing chain
`M_0 ⊆ M_1 ⊆ …` of `k`-subspaces (`M_i = 0` for `i < 0`) with
`M_i F_j ⊆ M_{i+j}`. -/
structure IsCompatibleFiltration (F : ℕ → Submodule k A) (Mf : ℕ → Submodule k M) :
    Prop where
  mono : Monotone Mf
  smul_mem : ∀ {i j : ℕ} {m : M} {a : A}, m ∈ Mf i → a ∈ F j →
    MulOpposite.op a • m ∈ Mf (i + j)
  exhaustive : ∀ m : M, ∃ i, m ∈ Mf i

  exhaustive : ∀ a : A, ∃ j, a ∈ F j

`gr M = ⊕_i M_i/M_{i-1}` is finitely generated over `gr^F A_n = k[x, ξ]`.

  compatible : IsCompatibleFiltration (orderFiltration k n) Γ

  (b : Module.Basis (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k V) : Prop
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsSymplecticBa.source:
/-- **Definition 2.8 (symplectic basis).** `e_1, …, e_n, f_1, …, f_n` with
`ω(e_i, f_j) = δ_ij` and `ω(e_i, e_j) = ω(f_i, f_j) = 0`. -/
def IsSymplecticBasis {n : ℕ} (ω : BilinForm k V) (b : Basis (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k V) :
    Prop :=
  (∀ i j, ω (b (Sum.inl i)) (b (Sum.inr j)) = if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ i j, ω (b (Sum.inl i)) (b (Sum.inl j)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ i j, ω (b (Sum.inr i)) (b (Sum.inr j)) = 0)

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.doc:
**Convention 2.2, normal form (existence).** Every element of `A_n(k)` can
be written as `∑_j p^j c_j` with `c_j ∈ C`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2_exists.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
  (d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
  ∃ L a, (∀ (j : ℕ), a j ∈ C k n) ∧ d = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, p k n ^ j * a j
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.source:
/-- **Convention 2.2, normal form (existence).** Every element of `A_n(k)` can
be written as `∑_j p^j c_j` with `c_j ∈ C`. -/
theorem convention_2_2_exists (n : ℕ) (d : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    ∃ (L : ℕ) (a : ℕ → PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)), (∀ j, a j ∈ C k n) ∧
      d = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, p k n ^ j * a j := by
  let b := pairStage_rightOrePBWBasis (B := IteratedPairStage k n)
  let c := b.repr (presentedToIterated k (n + 1) d)
  let L := c.support.sup id + 1
  have hsub : c.support ⊆ Finset.range L := by
    intro j hj
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.le_sup (f := id) hj))
  refine ⟨L, fun j => coordinateStageToPresented k n (c j).unop,
    fun j => (C_eq_range k n).symm ▸ ⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  have hd : presentedToIterated k (n + 1) d =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, c j • rightPBWMonomial (coordinateDerivation :
        OreDivisionDerivation (CoordinateStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n))) j := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← b.linearCombination_repr (presentedToIterated k (n + 1) d)]
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset _ hsub _ (by simp)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    simp [b, pairStage_rightOrePBWBasis]
    rfl
  have hback : d = stageToPresented k n (presentedToIterated k (n + 1) d) :=
    (DFunLike.congr_fun (iteratedToPresented_comp_presentedToIterated k (n + 1)) d).symm
  rw [hback, hd, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact stageToPresented_rightTerm k n j (c j).unop

  (d :
    RingQuot fun a b =>
      ∃ i j,
        a = FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j - FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
          b =
            (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)),
  ∃ L a,
    (∀ (j : ℕ),
        a j ∈
          Algebra.adjoin k
            (↑((RingQuot.liftAlgHom k)
                    ⟨(FreeAlgebra.lift k) fun i =>
                        (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                            ∃ i j,
                              a =
                                  FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                                    FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧

                          (FreeAlgebra.ι k
                            (Sum.casesOn i (fun val => Sum.inl val.succ) fun val =>
                              Sum.inr val.succ)),
                      ⋯⟩).range ∪
              {(RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                    ∃ i j,
                      a =
                          FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                            FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                        b =
                          (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                            (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                  (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl 0))})) ∧
      d =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L,
          (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                  ∃ i j,
                    a =
                        FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                          FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                      b =
                        (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                          (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))

            a j

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.doc:
**Convention 2.2, relations.** `x₁` is central in `C`, `[p, x₁] = 1`, and
the transverse algebra commutes with `x₁` and `p`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2_relations.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
  p k n * x₁ k n = x₁ k n * p k n + 1 ∧
    (∀ c ∈ C k n, x₁ k n * c = c * x₁ k n) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ transverse k n, t * x₁ k n = x₁ k n * t ∧ t * p k n = p k n * t
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.source:
/-- **Convention 2.2, relations.** `x₁` is central in `C`, `[p, x₁] = 1`, and
the transverse algebra commutes with `x₁` and `p`. -/
theorem convention_2_2_relations (n : ℕ) :
    p k n * x₁ k n = x₁ k n * p k n + 1 ∧
      (∀ c ∈ C k n, x₁ k n * c = c * x₁ k n) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ transverse k n, t * x₁ k n = x₁ k n * t ∧ t * p k n = p k n * t := by
  refine ⟨presentedMomentum_mul_coordinate k n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c hc
    induction hc using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
        rcases hx with ⟨w, rfl⟩ | hx
        · exact presentedCoordinate_commutes_previous k n w
        · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx]
    | algebraMap r => exact (Algebra.commutes r _).symm
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add, add_mul, hx, hy]
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [← mul_assoc, hx, mul_assoc, hy, mul_assoc]
  · rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(presentedCoordinate_commutes_previous k n w).symm,
      (presentedMomentum_commutes_previous k n w).symm⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.doc:
**Convention 2.2, normal form (uniqueness).** If `∑_{j<L} p^j c_j = 0`
with `c_j ∈ C`, then every `c_j = 0`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2_unique.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n L : ℕ)
  (a : ℕ → WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) (ha : ∀ (j : ℕ), a j ∈ C k n)
  (h0 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, p k n ^ j * a j = 0) (j : ℕ) : j < L → a j = 0
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.source:
/-- **Convention 2.2, normal form (uniqueness).** If `∑_{j<L} p^j c_j = 0`
with `c_j ∈ C`, then every `c_j = 0`. -/
theorem convention_2_2_unique (n L : ℕ) (a : ℕ → PresentedWeyl k (n + 1))
    (ha : ∀ j, a j ∈ C k n) (h0 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, p k n ^ j * a j = 0) :
    ∀ j < L, a j = 0 := by
  have hpre : ∀ j, ∃ z, coordinateStageToPresented k n z = a j := fun j => by
    have := ha j
    rw [C_eq_range] at this
    exact this
  choose b hb using hpre
  let D : OreDivisionDerivation (CoordinateStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n)) :=
    coordinateDerivation
  have hsum : rightPBWCombination D
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, Finsupp.single j (MulOpposite.op (b j))) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [rightPBWCombination_single]
    have himg : stageToPresented k n
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, MulOpposite.op (b j) • rightPBWMonomial D j) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sum, ← h0]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [stageToPresented_rightTerm, hb]
    have := congrArg (presentedToIterated k (n + 1)) himg
    rwa [presentedToIterated_stageToPresented, map_zero] at this
  have hzero := (rightPBWCombination_injective D) (hsum.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  intro j hj
  have hj' := congrArg (fun f : ℕ →₀ (CoordinateStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n))ᵐᵒᵖ => f j)
    hzero
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply, Finsupp.single_apply,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_range, ite_eq_left hj, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at hj'
  rw [← hb, MulOpposite.op_injective (hj'.trans MulOpposite.op_zero.symm), map_zero]

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.omega.doc:
**Definition 2.8 (standard symplectic form).** On `𝕍 = k^{2n}` with basis
`x_1, …, x_n, ∂_1, …, ∂_n`, `ω(u, v) = ∑_i (u_{x_i} v_{∂_i} - u_{∂_i} v_{x_i})`,
so `ω(x_i, ∂_j) = δ_ij` and `ω(x_i, x_j) = ω(∂_i, ∂_j) = 0`.  It is the
negative of the repository's `phasePairing`, which uses the opposite sign
convention.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.omega.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.omega.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
  LinearMap.BilinForm k (Characteristic.PhaseVar n → k)
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.omega.source:
/-- **Definition 2.8 (standard symplectic form).** On `𝕍 = k^{2n}` with basis
`x_1, …, x_n, ∂_1, …, ∂_n`, `ω(u, v) = ∑_i (u_{x_i} v_{∂_i} - u_{∂_i} v_{x_i})`,
so `ω(x_i, ∂_j) = δ_ij` and `ω(x_i, x_j) = ω(∂_i, ∂_j) = 0`.  It is the
negative of the repository's `phasePairing`, which uses the opposite sign
convention. -/
def omega (n : ℕ) : BilinForm k (PhaseVar n → k) :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ k (fun u v => -phasePairing k u v)
    (fun u v w => by rw [phasePairing_add_left, neg_add])
    (fun c u v => by rw [phasePairing_smul_left, smul_eq_mul, mul_neg])
    (fun u v w => by rw [phasePairing_add_right, neg_add])
    (fun c u v => by rw [phasePairing_smul_right, smul_eq_mul, mul_neg])

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.theorem_2_12.doc:
**Theorem 2.12 (Hilbert's Nullstellensatz).** Let `K` be algebraically
closed and `J ⊆ K[z_1, …, z_N]` an ideal (the variables indexed by any
finite type `σ`, e.g. `PhaseVar n` for `K[x, ξ]`).
(a) The maximal ideals of `K[z]` are exactly the `𝔪_a`, `a ↦ 𝔪_a` is
injective, and `V_K(J)` corresponds to the closed points of `V(J)`;
(b) `V_K(J) = ∅` iff `1 ∈ J`;
(c) `I(V_K(J)) = √J`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.theorem_2_12.signature:

  [Finite σ] (J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)) :
  ((∀ (M : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)), M.IsMaximal ↔ ∃ a, M = maxIdealAt K a) ∧
      Function.Injective (maxIdealAt K) ∧ ∀ (a : σ → K), a ∈ VK K J ↔ closedPoint K a ∈ V J) ∧
    (VK K J = ∅ ↔ 1 ∈ J) ∧ vanishingIdealOf K (VK K J) = J.radical
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.theorem_2_12.source:
/-- **Theorem 2.12 (Hilbert's Nullstellensatz).** Let `K` be algebraically
closed and `J ⊆ K[z_1, …, z_N]` an ideal (the variables indexed by any
finite type `σ`, e.g. `PhaseVar n` for `K[x, ξ]`).
(a) The maximal ideals of `K[z]` are exactly the `𝔪_a`, `a ↦ 𝔪_a` is
injective, and `V_K(J)` corresponds to the closed points of `V(J)`;
(b) `V_K(J) = ∅` iff `1 ∈ J`;
(c) `I(V_K(J)) = √J`. -/
theorem theorem_2_12 [IsAlgClosed K] [Finite σ] (J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)) :
    ((∀ M : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K), M.IsMaximal ↔ ∃ a, M = maxIdealAt K a) ∧
      Function.Injective (maxIdealAt K (σ := σ)) ∧
      ∀ a, a ∈ VK K J ↔ closedPoint K a ∈ V J) ∧
    (VK K J = ∅ ↔ (1 : MvPolynomial σ K) ∈ J) ∧
    vanishingIdealOf K (VK K J) = J.radical := by
  have hc : vanishingIdealOf K (VK K J) = J.radical := by
    rw [vanishingIdealOf, VK_eq_zeroLocus, MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical]
  refine ⟨⟨fun M => ?_, ?_, mem_VK_iff_closedPoint_mem_V K J⟩, ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩, hc⟩
  · simp only [maxIdealAt_eq_vanishingIdeal]
    exact MvPolynomial.isMaximal_iff_eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton
  · intro a b hab
    funext i
    have hmem : MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.C (a i) ∈ maxIdealAt K b :=
      hab ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_maxIdealAt_iff] at hmem
    simpa [sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] using hmem
  · have h1 : (1 : MvPolynomial σ K) ∈ J.radical := by
      rw [← hc, h, mem_vanishingIdealOf]
      simp
    exact (Ideal.radical_eq_top.mp ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr h1)).symm ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  · ext a
    simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    intro ha
    simpa using ha 1 h

∀ (K : Type u) [inst : Field K] {σ : Type v} [IsAlgClosed K] [Finite σ]

        M.IsMaximal ↔
          ∃ a, M = Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.C (a i))) ∧
      (Function.Injective fun a =>
          Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.C (a i))) ∧

Stafford38.Paper.Section7.corollary_6_3_.doc:
**Corollary 6.3 for left torsion modules.** Every finitely generated torsion
left `A_n(k)`-module is cyclic.  The left analogue of the printed proof
(`Section6.corollary_6_3_of` for the ring `A_n(k)ᵐᵒᵖ`, whose right modules are
the left `A_n(k)`-modules), fed with the left-handed identity `1 = Rd + SdF`
(`leftHandedIdentity`) and the left Ore condition; the two generators of the
left version of [Sta78, Thm. 3.7] come from the same identity.
Stafford38.Paper.Section7.corollary_6_3_.source:
/-- **Corollary 6.3 for left torsion modules.** Every finitely generated torsion
left `A_n(k)`-module is cyclic.  The left analogue of the printed proof
(`Section6.corollary_6_3_of` for the ring `A_n(k)ᵐᵒᵖ`, whose right modules are
the left `A_n(k)`-modules), fed with the left-handed identity `1 = Rd + SdF`
(`leftHandedIdentity`) and the left Ore condition; the two generators of the
left version of [Sta78, Thm. 3.7] come from the same identity. -/
theorem corollary_6_3_left : LeftCorollary_6_3.{u, v} := by
  intro k _ _ n M _ _ _ hM
  let ψ : (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖᵐᵒᵖ →+* WeylAlg k n := (RingEquiv.opOp (WeylAlg k n)).symm.toRingHom
  let : Module (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖᵐᵒᵖ M := Module.compHom M ψ
  have hsmul : ∀ (a : WeylAlg k n) (m : M),
      (MulOpposite.op (MulOpposite.op a) : (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖᵐᵒᵖ) • m = a • m := fun _ _ => rfl
  have hone : ∀ d : (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ, d ≠ 0 →
      ∃ F R S : (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ, (1 : (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ) = d * R + F * d * S := by
    intro d hd
    obtain ⟨R, S, F, h⟩ := leftHandedIdentity k n d.unop
      (fun h0 => hd (MulOpposite.unop_injective (by rw [h0, MulOpposite.unop_zero])))
    refine ⟨MulOpposite.op F, MulOpposite.op R, MulOpposite.op S, ?_⟩
    apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
    simp only [MulOpposite.unop_one, MulOpposite.unop_add, MulOpposite.unop_mul,
      MulOpposite.unop_op, h, mul_assoc]
  have : Module.Finite (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖᵐᵒᵖ M := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (Module.Finite.fg_top : (⊤ : Submodule (WeylAlg k n) M).FG)
    refine ⟨⟨s, ?_⟩⟩
    let N : Submodule (WeylAlg k n) M :=
      { carrier := Submodule.span (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖᵐᵒᵖ (s : Set M)
        add_mem' := fun ha hb => Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb
        zero_mem' := Submodule.zero_mem _
        smul_mem' := fun c x hx => by
          change c • x ∈ Submodule.span (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖᵐᵒᵖ (s : Set M)
          rw [← hsmul]
          exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx }
    have hN : (⊤ : Submodule (WeylAlg k n) M) ≤ N := by
      rw [← hs]
      exact Submodule.span_le.2 fun x hx => Submodule.subset_span hx
    exact eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ => hN Submodule.mem_top
  have hT : Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsTorsion (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ M := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hdm⟩ := hM m
    refine ⟨MulOpposite.op d, fun h => hd (MulOpposite.op_injective (by rw [h, MulOpposite.op_zero])),
      ?_⟩
    rw [hsmul, hdm]
  have hOre := weyl_leftOreCondition k n
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (Section6.corollary_6_3_of hOre hone hT
    ⟨Section6.two_generators_of_identity hOre hone hT,
      fun l hl => Section6.stably_generated_of_identity hOre hone hT l (by omega)⟩).1
  refine ⟨m, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hm x
  exact ⟨a.unop, ha⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section7.evolutionaryId.doc:
**Evolutionary identity.** For `r ≥ 1` and `px = xp + 1` in a `k`-algebra,
`d = p^r - ∑_j a_j x^{m_j}` with each `a_j` commuting with `x` and `p` has
`1 = dR + x^r d S`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section7.evolutionaryId.source:
/-- **Evolutionary identity.** For `r ≥ 1` and `px = xp + 1` in a `k`-algebra,
`d = p^r - ∑_j a_j x^{m_j}` with each `a_j` commuting with `x` and `p` has
`1 = dR + x^r d S`. -/
theorem evolutionaryIdentity : EvolutionaryIdentity.{u, v} := by
  intro k _ _ D _ _ x p hw r hr J a m hx hp
  have hmem : ∀ t ∈ List.ofFn (fun j => (a j, m j)), ∃ j, t = (a j, m j) := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 ht
    exact ⟨j, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨R, S, h⟩ := Stafford38.Evolution.evolutionaryCorollary k hw hr
    (List.ofFn fun j => (a j, m j))
    (fun t ht => by obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hmem t ht; exact hx j)
    (fun t ht => by obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hmem t ht; exact hp j) rfl
  exact ⟨R, S, by rw [← potentialSum_ofFn x J a m]; exact h⟩
Stafford38.Paper.Section7.evolutionaryId.unfolded:
∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field k] [CharZero k] (D : Type v) [inst_2 : Ring D] [Algebra k D] (x p : D),

    ∀ (r : ℕ),
      1 ≤ r →
        ∀ (J : ℕ) (a : Fin J → D) (m : Fin J → ℕ),
          (∀ (j : Fin J), a j * x = x * a j) →
            (∀ (j : Fin J), a j * p = p * a j) →
              ∃ R S, 1 = (p ^ r - ∑ j, a j * x ^ m j) * R + x ^ r * (p ^ r - ∑ j, a j * x ^ m j) * S

∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ)
  (d :
    RingQuot fun a b =>
      ∃ i j,

          b =
            (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))

    ∃ ell R S,
      (∃ M N,
          ∃ (_ : M * Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k * M.transpose = Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) (_ :
            N * Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k * N.transpose = Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) (_ : M * N = 1)

                            b =
                              (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                                (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)))

                      ∃ i j,
                        a =
                            FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                              FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧

                      d ∈
                        Submodule.span k
                          {z |
                            ∃ a p,

                                z =
                                  (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                                      ∃ i j,

                                                    FreeAlgebra.ι k

Stafford38Challenge.EvolutionaryIdentity.doc:
**Section 7, evolutionary identity** (tex lines 1631–1634): for `r ≥ 1`, in
every `k`-algebra `D` with `px = xp + 1`, the element
`d = p^r − ∑_j a_j x^{m_j}`, each `a_j` commuting with `x` and `p`, has
`R, S` with `1 = dR + x^r d S`.
Stafford38Challenge.EvolutionaryIdentity.source:
/-- **Section 7, evolutionary identity** (tex lines 1631–1634): for `r ≥ 1`, in
every `k`-algebra `D` with `px = xp + 1`, the element
`d = p^r − ∑_j a_j x^{m_j}`, each `a_j` commuting with `x` and `p`, has
`R, S` with `1 = dR + x^r d S`. -/
def EvolutionaryIdentity : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] (D : Type v) [Ring D] [Algebra k D] (x p : D),
    p * x = x * p + 1 → ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → ∀ (J : ℕ) (a : Fin J → D) (m : Fin J → ℕ),
      (∀ j, a j * x = x * a j) → (∀ j, a j * p = p * a j) →
        ∃ R S : D, (1 : D) = (p ^ r - ∑ j, a j * x ^ m j) * R +
          x ^ r * (p ^ r - ∑ j, a j * x ^ m j) * S

Stafford38Challenge.HasDifferentialIdent.doc:
The identity `1 = dR + FdS` in the ring `D_k(B)` of finite-order
`k`-linear differential operators on `B`: for every nonzero `d ∈ D_k(B)` there
are `F, R, S ∈ D_k(B)` with `1 = dR + FdS`.

Stafford38Challenge.HasDifferentialIdentity.{u, v} (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing k]
  [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] : Prop
Stafford38Challenge.HasDifferentialIdent.source:
/-- The identity `1 = dR + FdS` in the ring `D_k(B)` of finite-order
`k`-linear differential operators on `B`: for every nonzero `d ∈ D_k(B)` there
are `F, R, S ∈ D_k(B)` with `1 = dR + FdS`. -/
def HasDifferentialIdentity (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing k] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra k B] : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Module.End k B, IsDifferentialOperator k B d → d ≠ 0 →
    ∃ F R S : Module.End k B, IsDifferentialOperator k B F ∧ IsDifferentialOperator k B R ∧
      IsDifferentialOperator k B S ∧ (1 : Module.End k B) = d * R + F * d * S

Stafford38Challenge.IsDifferentialOperat.doc:
`P` is a `k`-linear differential operator of order at most `N` on the
commutative `k`-algebra `B` (Grothendieck): every iterated commutator
`[…[[P, b₀], b₁], …, b_N]` with multiplication operators vanishes, where
`[Q, b] = Q ∘ b − b ∘ Q`.
Stafford38Challenge.IsDifferentialOperat.signature:
Stafford38Challenge.IsDifferentialOperatorOfOrder.{u, v} (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing k]
  [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (N : ℕ) (P : Module.End k B) : Prop
Stafford38Challenge.IsDifferentialOperat.source:
/-- `P` is a `k`-linear differential operator of order at most `N` on the
commutative `k`-algebra `B` (Grothendieck): every iterated commutator
`[…[[P, b₀], b₁], …, b_N]` with multiplication operators vanishes, where
`[Q, b] = Q ∘ b − b ∘ Q`. -/
def IsDifferentialOperatorOfOrder (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing k] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra k B] (N : ℕ) (P : Module.End k B) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : List B, b.length = N + 1 →
    b.foldl (fun Q c => Q * LinearMap.mulLeft k c - LinearMap.mulLeft k c * Q) P = 0

Stafford38Challenge.IsStablyCyclic.doc:
Stafford's *stably cyclic* [Sta78, p. 435], as quoted in the proof of
Corollary 6.3 (tex line 1619): "given `l ≥ 1` and `a_1, …, a_{l+1} ∈ T` that
generate `T`, there exist `f_i ∈ A_n` such that `a_i + a_{l+1} f_i`,
`i = 1, …, l`, also generate `T`".

Stafford38Challenge.IsStablyCyclic.{u, v} (A : Type u) (T : Type v) [Ring A] [AddCommGroup T]
  [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T] : Prop
Stafford38Challenge.IsStablyCyclic.source:
/-- Stafford's *stably cyclic* [Sta78, p. 435], as quoted in the proof of
Corollary 6.3 (tex line 1619): "given `l ≥ 1` and `a_1, …, a_{l+1} ∈ T` that
generate `T`, there exist `f_i ∈ A_n` such that `a_i + a_{l+1} f_i`,
`i = 1, …, l`, also generate `T`". -/
def IsStablyCyclic (A : Type u) (T : Type v) [Ring A] [AddCommGroup T] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T] :
    Prop :=
  ∀ l ≥ 1, ∀ a : Fin (l + 1) → T, Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range a) = ⊤ →
    ∃ f : Fin l → A, Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ
      (Set.range fun i : Fin l => a i.castSucc + (MulOpposite.op (f i) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • a (Fin.last l)) =
        ⊤

Stafford38Challenge.PaperTheorem_1_1.doc:
**Theorem 1.1.**  For every field of characteristic zero `k`, every `n ≥ 0`
and every nonzero `d ∈ A_n(k)`, there exists an `F ∈ A_n(k)` such that
`A_n(k) = dA_n(k) + FdA_n(k)`, or equivalently, there exist `F, S, R ∈ A_n(k)`
such that `1 = dR + FdS`.  Moreover, if `n ≥ 1`, one may choose
`F = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)^{deg_B d}` for a linear `ω`-preserving automorphism `g`.
Stafford38Challenge.PaperTheorem_1_1.source:
/-- **Theorem 1.1.**  For every field of characteristic zero `k`, every `n ≥ 0`
and every nonzero `d ∈ A_n(k)`, there exists an `F ∈ A_n(k)` such that
`A_n(k) = dA_n(k) + FdA_n(k)`, or equivalently, there exist `F, S, R ∈ A_n(k)`
such that `1 = dR + FdS`.  Moreover, if `n ≥ 1`, one may choose
`F = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)^{deg_B d}` for a linear `ω`-preserving automorphism `g`. -/
def PaperTheorem_1_1 : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ) (d : WeylAlg k n), d ≠ 0 →
    (∃ F : WeylAlg k n, (⊤ : Submodule (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ (WeylAlg k n)) =
        Submodule.span (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ {d} ⊔ Submodule.span (WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ {F * d}) ∧
      (∃ F S R : WeylAlg k n, (1 : WeylAlg k n) = d * R + F * d * S) ∧
      (∀ hn : 1 ≤ n, ∃ g : Matrix.symplecticGroup (Fin n) k, ∃ R S : WeylAlg k n,
        (1 : WeylAlg k n) = d * R +
          phiG k n g⁻¹ (x₁ k hn) ^ Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.bernsteinDegree k d * d * S)

/-- A source coordinate obtained from an invertible symplectic linear change
of the canonical Weyl generators. -/
def IsLinearWeylCoordinate (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (ell : WeylAlg k (n + 1)) : Prop :=
  ∃ (M N : Matrix (PhaseVar (n + 1)) (PhaseVar (n + 1)) k)
      (_hM : M * standardForm k (n + 1) * Matrix.transpose M =
        standardForm k (n + 1))
      (_hN : N * standardForm k (n + 1) * Matrix.transpose N =
        standardForm k (n + 1))
      (_hMN : M * N = 1) (_hNM : N * M = 1),
      ell = linearCombination k N (generator k (n + 1))
        (.inl (0 : Fin (n + 1)))

  ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ)
